_doc: Bestiary. All numbers deterministic: no hit chance, no damage rolls. bite_count = sprigs eaten per bite; telegraph_seconds = visible wind-up before the bite lands; itch_damage = damage taken before it shakes attackers off; seeds = shrine seeds when the corpse is carried home. sleeps_by_day: dormant until the knight or a sprig enters wake_radius. night: spawns only at night, retreats at dawn. itch_time: the shake needs both itch_damage taken AND itch_time elapsed since the last shake, so a burst cannot shake it early. back_multiplier: damage taken from behind. roams: wanders on its own around its home. prey: runs from the gnome and the squad instead of hunting them.

enemies.name: Bulb Grub
enemies.line: Sleeps in the open. Wakes hungry. Three sprigs a bite. Throw onto its back; pull off when it shakes.

enemies.name: Dusk Stalker
enemies.line: Comes at dusk, in twos and threes, for whatever is left in the field. Gone at dawn.

enemies.name: Field Beetle
enemies.line: Skitters about the field and bolts when you come close. Six seeds if you can catch it.
